description: This Java source file defines the CatalogUrlServlet class, a servlet handling URL routing and URL generation for product and category pages within an e-commerce application, specifically for the 'product' and 'category' sections under the 'catalog' URL mount point.

classes.name: CatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: Servlet class handling URL parsing, request dispatching, and URL construction for product and category pages.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates POST requests to the doGet method for handling.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes incoming GET requests, parses URL path info to determine product or category IDs, sets request attributes, and forwards to appropriate view.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a product or category page based on request context, current and previous category IDs.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a product or category page based on provided context path, breadcrumb trail, and category/product IDs.
